resources.string: Permanently deletes your Cablegram account and its data.
Delete your account on the web
This deletes everything at once and cannot be undone. There is no grace period.
Your profiles and every paired phone and TV
Your library, watch progress and My List
The link to your Telegram account, and this phone\'s Telegram sign-in
Any files Cablegram stores for you
Videos in your own Telegram channel are not deleted. They belong to your Telegram account, not to Cablegram.
Video files on this phone stay on this phone.
TVs that are signed in to your Telegram account stay signed in until you end their sessions in Telegram, under Settings, Devices.
To confirm it is you, we email a 6-digit code to your account\'s address.
We sent it to %1$s. It expires in 15 minutes.
We couldn\'t send the code. Check your connection and try again in a minute.
Your account, household, library and everything listed above will be deleted now. This cannot be undone.
That code is not right, or it expired. Nothing was deleted. Try again, or send a new code.
Too many attempts. Nothing was deleted. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
Your session has expired. Nothing was deleted. Sign out, sign in again, then retry.
Can\'t reach Cablegram. Nothing was deleted. Check your connection and try again.
Something went wrong and your account was not deleted. Try again in a moment.
Sends diagnostic error traces to help us fix playback problems and crashes. No video titles, file names or passwords are sent.
Send diagnostic info (device model, Android version, app version and recent errors) to help us investigate. No media titles, file names or passwords are sent.
